verdict.rationale: Cekura's own docs include a cron-job guide for setting up and managing automated cron jobs that run agent testing and evaluation calls on a schedule and alert on failure. That is first-party recurring scheduling of test workflows; GitHub Actions scheduling is a host-platform capability and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: detail on schedule configuration options (cron syntax, frequency, workflow scope), evidence that schedules can be created or managed via API/CLI/MCP for AI-native use, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
